priorities.heading: Ending Corruption: Make Washington work for Minnesotans, not special interests
priorities.quote: In the Senate, Peggy will fight to ban corporate money in our elections and require disclosure of all donors.

priorities.heading: Healthcare: Everyone should be able to access and afford the care they need
priorities.quote: Peggy believes healthcare is a human right and will fight for Medicare for All, ensuring providers, clinics, and hospitals have the resources to give people the care they deserve.

priorities.heading: Affording Your Life: Putting more money in Minnesotans’ pockets
priorities.quote: Peggy co-chaired the Raise the Wage campaign in Minnesota and supports a $17 federal minimum wage tied to inflation to keep up with the increased costs of food, housing, and everyday essentials.

housing.heading: Housing: Affording a place to call home
housing.quote: Peggy supports The Homes Act and taking other bold steps to create more affordable options and good union jobs to get the work done.

immigration.heading: Immigration: Overhauling our broken immigration system
immigration.quote: Peggy believes that ICE is out of control and that we must dismantle the agency and reimagine an immigration system rooted in dignity, safety, and due process for all.

foreign-policy.heading: Foreign Policy
foreign-policy.quote: Peggy believes that establishing ongoing peace and stability in the Middle East requires a lasting ceasefire and a two-state solution which allows for a secure Israel and Palestinian self-determination.

climate-energy.heading: Climate: Protecting our planet & creating a green economy
climate-energy.quote: Peggy opposes the Trump Administration’s rollback of investments in clean energy and supports clean energy solutions like wind and solar that also create new union jobs in all areas of our state.

priorities.heading: Agriculture
priorities.quote: I will support policies that protect small and mid-sized farms, cut unnecessary red tape, and increase access to sustainable agriculture grants.

priorities.heading: Education
priorities.quote: I will fight for stable public school funding, expanded early childhood programs, and competitive pay for our teachers.

priorities.heading: Energy
priorities.quote: I support expanding access to solar, wind, and geothermal energy through incentives, grid upgrades, and community-owned renewable projects that keep profits local.

cost-of-living.heading: Jobs & Economy
cost-of-living.quote: I’ll champion small businesses, support workforce development, and expand access to childcare and job training.

health-care.heading: Healthcare

foreign-policy.heading: National Security

priorities.heading: Stop The Fraud
priorities.quote: As our Senator, Michele will cosponsor and lead the Deporting Fraudsters Act with Senators Ted Cruz, Mike Lee and John Cornyn.

priorities.heading: Law and Order
priorities.quote: As our Senator, Michele will push for more funding, top-quality equipment and training for the men and women who put their own safety at risk to protect us all, and fight against efforts to remove the legal protections they need to do their job.

priorities.heading: Cut Costs and Taxes for the Middle Class
